ctx.x: Oh yes, had a place where I played with your band that 35 years ago I would have had a hard time delivering a package in there.

I get credit for having the first mixed band in white rooms in this city; mixed and I never realized that until the agent at that time, who was Tommy Reed, told me, and you backed -- you confirmed that down at the local because I checked with you to make sure because I couldn't believe that in that day and age, 1961, '62, but you said that's true.
